findings.title: SBOMs are generated but not signed or attested
findings.impact: SBOM integrity is not verifiable by consumers.
findings.recommendation: Sign SBOMs (cosign attest) and publish a provenance attestation.

findings.title: No license policy / dependency-review gate
findings.note: LICENSE is present (proprietary all-rights-reserved); dependency licenses ungated.
evidence: no dependency-review action / license allow-list in CI
findings.recommendation: Add a license allow-list gate and dependency-review on PRs.

report:
SBOMs are produced for production images (deploy
workflow) but not signed/attested; no dependency-review or license policy gate
is wired.
